How We Work  /  Our Approach

The technology keeps changing. How we work does not.

Most technology help fails for the same reason: the work gets done, but nobody is left who understands it. The account is in a consultant's name, the password is in a consultant's head, and the next problem starts from zero.

We work the other way around. Whatever the engagement costs and however long it runs, you end it holding the keys and the explanation.

What that looks like

The same on a home visit and on a county contract.

  1. 01 We listen before we recommend. The first conversation is about what you are trying to do, not about what we sell. Sometimes the honest answer is that you do not need us yet, and we will say so.
  2. 02 We explain as we go. You should be able to repeat back what we did and why. If an explanation needs an acronym, it is our job to find a better explanation.
  3. 03 We leave you better off than we found you. Written down, in your name, and workable by whoever comes next. The measure of a good engagement is that you need us less afterward.

What every engagement includes

Notes you keep

Passwords, accounts, and what we changed — documented in plain language and handed to you.

One person

You talk to the person doing the work. No tiers, no tickets, no repeating your story.

No lock-in

Everything is in your name and under your control. If you leave, nothing has to be untangled.

Technology help for people, and their businesses, organizations, and communities.
